title: Principal Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen-fast.

Overview
We are seeking a Principal Product Analyst to own ZoomInfo 's PLG measurement system - the framework that defines how the company evaluates customer adoption, monetization, retention, and growth across its product portfolio.
This is not a traditional reporting or dashboarding role. It is a strategic leadership role responsible for defining how the organization measures PLG success, identifying the behaviors that drive business outcomes, and generating the insights that shape product investments and growth strategy.
The ideal candidate combines strong analytical depth with operational rigor and a builder mentality. They are comfortable operating in ambiguity, leading investigations from scratch, and influencing decisions across Product, Engineering, Go-To-Market, and Leadership teams. They also embrace AI-native ways of working, leveraging automation and emerging technologies to fundamentally improve how analytics is performed and scaled. PLG experience is a plus but not required.
What You'll Do
Product Growth Measurement & Operating System

• Establish the company’s source of truth for PLG performance, including KPI definitions, scorecards, executive reporting, and performance benchmarks.

• Define leading indicators that predict customer activation, product adoption, conversion, retention, and expansion outcomes.

• Ensure measurement consistency across products, teams, and business units, enabling a unified view of customer growth and product performance.

• Develop scalable frameworks that connect customer behavior to business outcomes and investment decisions.

Customer Journey Analytics & Growth Diagnostics:

• Own analytical understanding of the end-to-end customer journey, from acquisition and onboarding through monetization and long-term retention.

• Identify behavioral patterns, friction points, and conversion barriers that impact activation, adoption, retention, and expansion.

• Develop customer segmentation frameworks that reveal differences in growth outcomes across personas, customer segments, and product experiences.

• Lead investigations into significant changes in PLG performance, diagnosing root causes and quantifying business impact.

• Identify the behaviors and product experiences most strongly associated with successful customer outcomes and long-term value creation.

Product Strategy & Growth Insights

• Influence product investment and roadmap decisions by quantifying opportunity size, identifying high-leverage growth opportunities, and evaluating tradeoffs across competing initiatives.

• Serve as a strategic advisor to Product, Growth, and GTM leadership on customer behavior trends, adoption patterns, and monetization opportunities.

• Build analytical frameworks that help teams prioritize investments across onboarding, activation, engagement, monetization, retention, and expansion.

• Define measurement strategies for major product initiatives and ensure business impact is accurately assessed.

• Guide experimentation efforts across the PLG funnel, helping teams prioritize, evaluate, and scale growth opportunities.

• Deliver executive-level insights that inform product strategy, growth planning, and resource allocation.

AI-Native Analytics & Operational Excellence

• Redesign analytics workflows around AI-first operating principles rather than traditional manual processes.

description:
About Welocalize 
Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. title: Summer Intern 2027
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a 10 week internship program starting from 29th June 2027

Salary - £50,000 (per annum)

We’re looking for a super smart student who is great with numbers and loves problem solving to come and apply your skills in a start up environment and have a big impact on our business and how we do things.

What you'll be doing

- Use your analytical and problem-solving skills to generate key insights from data, and use that insight to drive meaningful change in our strategy

- Using data and modelling to ground assumptions for our NPV model, such as predicting what default rates will be in the future, and using that to inform our lending deicsions

- Using data and analytics to drive decisions about who we should lend to, and how much we should lend to them, and how that changes with the economy and competition changes

- Conducting hypothesis testing, and using your findings to change how we do things in areas such as lending strategy, pricing, and fraud detection

- Presenting your findings to senior leaders in the company, then work with the product/tech team to get them implemented

What we're looking for

- A university student in their penultimate year (can be undergraduates, masters or PhD students)

- Must have coding skills in Python or SQL

- Someone that loves numbers! You’ll be working with numbers every single day in this role so you’ll be able to demonstrate your ability to work with complex data sets, analyse them and draw insights

- You’ll have a natural curiosity and love to dig into things to understand how they work

- Startup mindset. We’re a fast-growth tech startup so you’ll be super excited to work in an entrepreneurial environment and have a real impact on the business

Interview Process

- 15-minute online test

- Coding Take Home Task

- Remote (video call) Task Debrief (60 mins)

- Remote (video call) case study (60 mins)

- In-person case study (60 min) + Culture Add Conversation (15 minutes) + a chance to meet other recent grads over lunch (30-45 minutes)

LIFE AT LENDABLE

- Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

- Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

- Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

title: Sr Director, Finance Technology Analyst, Remote US
description:
About the role:
Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner ’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner ’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.
CIOs are navigating a period of unprecedented complexity in technology investment decisions. The growth of cloud, AI, consumption-based technology services, and the shift from project-based funding to ongoing product and platform investments have fundamentally changed how technology costs are incurred, governed and measured. As technology finance evolves from a cost management discipline to a strategic enabler of technology investment decisions and business value, Gartner is seeking a leader who can help shape the future agenda for CIOs and their teams across technology budgeting, spend transparency, cost optimization, cloud and AI economics, and value-focused governance.
Important: This is not a corporate FP&A position. The role focuses on advising CIOs on IT Financial Management (ITFM), including technology budgeting, investment governance, cost transparency, cloud and AI economics, and technology value realization. Candidates should bring experience supporting CIO organizations and applying ITFM, TBM, or FinOps practices to improve decision-making and business outcomes. General FP&A backgrounds without technology-specific finance experience will not be considered.
Your experience will ideally come from working closely with CIOs, including:

• Experience leading or advising IT Financial Management disciplines, including technology budgeting, cost transparency, benchmarking, service costing, strategic cost management, and cloud/AI spend governance.

• Understanding of the ITFM, TBM and FinOps technology landscape, including experience evaluating relevant vendors and solutions.

• Demonstrated expertise in the economic and governance implications of cloud and AI, including unit economics, consumption-based pricing, FinOps practices, and the impact of vendor pricing changes on CIO investment decisions and value realization.
What you will do:

• Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content

• Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act

• Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward

• Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts

• Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda

• Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights

• Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions

• Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings

A day in the life:
The Group Director, Core is Power Digital's senior client relationship and revenue leader for a portfolio of primarily small business, founder-led clients. Your clients are often making their first serious investment in outside marketing help - the founder is usually the client, the budget is real money out of their own pocket, and a single underperforming month can feel existential in a way it rarely does at the enterprise level. You manage a higher-volume portfolio than almost any other Group Director role, and you run it the way a disciplined fund manager runs a broad, diversified book: fewer swings for the fences on any single account, more rigor in the system that keeps every account healthy. You are the executive a founder calls directly - there's no committee and no VP layer between you and the person who built the business - and the leader an Account Director never wants to let down. The roles you consistently play day-to-day are: portfolio growth owner, talent multiplier, tech forward leader and AI systems thinker.

title: Learning Experiences Creator
description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit is where millions of people learn to build software - and our documentation and learning content are where they get going or give up. We're taking ownership of that experience, and we're looking for a Learning Experience Creator who can make it worthy of the product: someone who turns product knowledge into experiences people actually use - clear written docs, guided learning, short video, interactive experiences - findable at the moment of need, accurate every time, and genuinely enjoyable.

You're a learning-experience creator first. You understand how people actually learn a product - what they're trying to accomplish, where they get stuck, what format serves each moment - and you move fluidly between writing a crisp help article, designing a hands-on walkthrough, and producing a short video. Underneath it all, you're a storyteller: you know how to earn attention in the first few seconds, hold it against real-world attention spans, and make ideas stick - and sometimes make something people can't help but share. You're also a builder: unafraid to try new formats and experiment, you read the data and listen to customers, and you continually improve and evolve with speed as our product evolves. You'll turn complex things into simple, useful experiences, and you'll own how well they land.

The Mission: help every user - external customers and internal teams - self-serve to reach their creative and business goals, with content so good, so current, and so findable that they don't need to open a ticket. Success looks like real ticket deflection, faster activation, and high CSAT.

 

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- New documentation and learning content. You'll populate our documentation and learning surfaces with new, accurate, plain-language content - help articles, answer-first FAQs, goal-based tutorials, and rebuilt getting-started paths - prioritized by real reader and ticket data, made at volume with the help of our AI- native content tools.

- The content lifecycle. Content isn't done when it ships. You'll keep the library current through every product launch - freshness reviews, launch-day updates, retiring what's stale - so nothing published contradicts the product. Our pipeline flags what's drifting; you own making it right.

- Learning experiences across formats. Written first where reading serves best - plus short-form video, microlearning, interactive courses, quick walkthroughs, GIFs, and in-product tips. You pick the format that fits the job, not the other way around, and you bring a storyteller's instinct for attention and memorability to every one - learning content competes with everything else on someone's screen, and yours wins. You keep pushing into new, innovative experiences as our tools grow.

- A content calendar built for effectiveness. You plan what gets made and when - covering the topics customers most need help with, sequenced for maximum impact, so the library actually answers the questions people are asking.

- Findability. You make sure content is easy to discover - titled, tagged, and structured so people (and the AI assistants that read our docs) find the right answer through search, at the moment of need. Great content nobody can find doesn't deflect anything, and this is yours to own.

- Engagement and outcomes. You care whether it worked - reader feedback, findability, completion and watch-through, self-serve resolution, deflection, CSAT - and you tune the calendar and the craft based on what the data and customers tell you.

- A recognizable voice. A consistent, human style across docs, learning, and video that makes every piece feel like part of one connected experience, whether someone reads a single article or completes a whole cour

title: Chief Actuary
description:
The Finance team at Clover Health is a group of strategic partners providing financial and operational insights that drive informed decision-making and efficient capital allocation. Guided by our core values of excellence, accountability, and collaboration, we provide actionable recommendations to improve health outcomes and reduce costs while ensuring financial integrity and innovation.

Actuarial is at the center of some of Clover's most important decisions-from pricing and forecasting to reserving, medical economics, and long-term strategy. As Chief Actuary, you'll lead and evolve this function during a pivotal stage of the company's growth, helping shape how we deploy AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve decision-making across the business.

This isn't a traditional Chief Actuary role. We're looking for someone who can combine deep actuarial expertise with modern technology, building AI-enabled workflows that transform how actuarial work gets done while maintaining the rigor, transparency, and governance required in a highly regulated environment. You'll partner closely with leaders across Finance, Clinical, Growth, Operations, and Product to influence company strategy while building a best-in-class actuarial organization.
As a Chief Actuary, you will:

• Lead Clover's enterprise actuarial function, including pricing, forecasting, reserving, medical economics, Part D, Stars analytics, and bid strategy.

• Build AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort, accelerate insight generation, and improve actuarial decision-making while ensuring explainability, governance, and regulatory compliance.

• Assume responsibility for actuarial opinions, reserve adequacy, and related regulatory actuarial requirements, including transitioning responsibilities currently supported by external actuarial partners.

• Guide reserving methodology, IBNR development, forecasting, and emerging experience analysis to provide timely, reliable financial insights.

• Partner with Finance leadership to strengthen forecasting, planning, capital management, and enterprise performance measurement.

• Collaborate with Medical Economics to identify healthcare cost trends, evaluate interventions, and develop strategies that improve member outcomes while managing medical expense.

• Drive adoption of modern analytics tools and AI capabilities across the actuarial organization, helping the team operate faster, smarter, and with greater transparency.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating complex actuarial concepts into clear business recommendations.

• Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing actuarial organization, including organizational design, performance management, workforce capacity, and development of actuarial and analytical talent.

• Build strong partnerships across Finance, Clinical, Operations, Growth, Data Science, and Engineering to ensure actuarial insights are embedded in strategic decision-making.

• Establish and maintain actuarial governance, model review, documentation, control, and validation standards that support regulatory compliance, financial integrity, and sound executive decision-making.

• Build trusted relationships across Finance and key business partners.

• Assess the current actuarial organization, tools, and operating model.

• Develop a roadmap for AI adoption and workflow automation across the actuarial function.

• Gain deep familiarity with Clover's pricing, forecasting, reserving, and medical economics processes.

First 6 Months

• Begin implementing AI-enabled actuarial w

description:
Job Title: Experienced Clinical Research Associate Sponsor-dedicated

Job Overview
Perform monitoring and site management work to ensure that sites are conducting the study(ies) and reporting study data as required by the study protocol, applicable regulations and guidelines, and sponsor requirements.
Essential Functions
• Perform site monitoring visits (selection, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits) in accordance with contracted scope of work and Good Clinical Practice.

• Administer protocol and related study training to assigned sites and establish regular lines of communication with sites to manage ongoing project expectations and issues.

• Create and maintain appropriate documentation regarding site management, monitoring visit findings and action plans by submitting regular visit reports, generating follow-up letters and other required study documentation.
• Collaborate and liaise with study team members for project execution support as appropriate.
• If applicable, may be accountable for supporting development of project subject recruitment plan on a per site basis.
• If applicable, may be accountable for site financial management according to executed clinical trial agreement and retrieve invoices according to local requirement.
Qualifications
• High School Diploma or equivalent Degree in scientific discipline or health care preferred.
• Requires at least 2 years of year of on-site monitoring experience.
• Equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be accepted in lieu of degree.
• Good knowledge of, and skill in applying, applicable clinical research regulatory requirements.
• i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines.
• Good therapeutic and protocol knowledge as provided in company training.
• Computer skills including proficiency in use of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint and use of a laptop computer and iPhone and iPad (where applicable).
• Written and verbal communication skills including good command of Greek and English language.
• Organizational and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers, and clients.

Trainline is a FTSE 250 global travel tech business, and our Tax team plays a central role in how we manage our financial responsibilities across the Group. - Review and manage UK and EU VAT return submissions via Making Tax Digital software, and oversee Operational Transfer Pricing across Group entities, ensuring intercompany agreements are maintained and invoicing is operating as expected.

- Champion tax process improvement across the business, identifying automation opportunities, communicating best practices, and delivering training to the wider team to embed lasting change.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Beacon Funding is seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer to test existing and new applications across our technology ecosystem, spanning internal systems (origination, underwriting, servicing, and portfolio management) and customer- and dealer-facing portals. This role combines manual and automated testing to identify and isolate defects across both legacy and current platforms, and works as an embedded member of an Agile Scrum team to ensure quality is built into the development lifecycle rather than caught at the end of it. We're looking for someone who actively applies AI-assisted testing technologies - for test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent defect analysis - to increase coverage and reduce the manual maintenance burden on the automation suite.

Job Responsibilities

• Perform manual and automated testing on existing and new applications, including internal origination, underwriting, and servicing systems as well as customer- and dealer-facing portals.

• Design, execute, and maintain test cases and automated test scripts to validate functionality across legacy and current platforms.

• Analyze test data and results to identify defects, isolate root cause, and document technical issues clearly for engineering teams.

• Collaborate with developers, product owners, and business stakeholders to reproduce issues, clarify requirements, and validate fixes.

• Participate as an active member of an Agile Scrum team - sprint planning, backlog refinement, story review, and retrospectives - to build quality into the development process from the start.

• Develop and extend automated test coverage using a test automation framework.

• Evaluate and apply AI-assisted testing techniques - including AI-generated test cases from requirements/user stories, self-healing test scripts, and intelligent test selection/prioritization - to expand automation coverage and cut maintenance overhead.

• Use AI-based tools to accelerate analysis of test results, logs, and failure patterns, surfacing likely root cause faster than manual triage alone.

• Track and manage defects through the team's bug-tracking system, providing clear reproduction steps, severity, and impact assessments.

• Support regression testing across releases affecting both internal tools and customer/dealer-facing applications.

• Identify bottlenecks in the QA process and swim lane, and recommend process, workflow, or tooling improvements to reduce backlog risk and manual dependency.

Job Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, quality assurance, or engineering emphasis or equivalent preferred

• 4-6 years of experience in software quality assurance, combining manual and automated testing.

• Experience testing web applications; comfort working across both legacy and modern platforms.

• Working knowledge of a test automation framework and scripting for automated tests.

• Strong aptitude and eagerness to adopt AI-assisted testing tools and techniques (e.g., AI-generated test cases, self-healing automation scripts, AI-driven test prioritization or log/anomaly analysis). This is an emerging space - a builder mindset and willingness to experiment matter more here than prior hands-on tenure with AI-specific tooling.

• Experience with a bug-tracking or test-management tool.

• Basic SQL skills for data validation.

• Experience working within Agile Scrum teams.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to isolate root cause across multi-system workflows.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills for documenting defects and collaborating with a distributed team.

• Experience testing applications in financial services, lending, or equipment leasing is preferred.

• Exposure to API testing is preferred.

• Experience testing customer- or dealer-facing web portals is preferred.

Benefits

• Group Mediclaim Policy

• Parental Insurance Coverage

• Accident Policy

• Retirement Benefits (Provident Fund)

• Gratuity

• Overt

description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Sentry's SDKs instrument dozens of platforms and our ingest pipeline takes in billions of events every day. The Telemetry Experience team owns what happens next: the product surfaces and APIs where that telemetry turns into something a developer can actually debug with.

As a Senior Software Engineer on Telemetry Experience, you'll own that experience across the sentry.io http://sentry.io product - Python/Django and Postgres on the backend, React and TypeScript on the frontend. You'll work upstream with our SDK teams on what gets sent and with our ingest teams on how it arrives, then own the part customers actually touch: the APIs, the workflows, and the interfaces where it all lands. Your job is to make that feel native to every developer who uses it, whether they ship a backend service, a mobile app, or a game.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

- Own projects end to end. Take a problem from a rough customer complaint through scoping, design, implementation across the stack, rollout, and measurement. You'll write the design doc, cut the work into shippable pieces, and stay with it until the numbers move

- Work across the full stack of the Sentry monolith. React and TypeScript in the browser, Django and Postgres behind the API. Most projects here touch both, and the interesting decisions live at the seam

- Partner closely with SDK and ingest teams. Telemetry arrives exactly as the SDKs send it and as the pipeline shapes it. You'll shape those contracts together with the engineers who own them, rather than working around what shows up

- Collaborate daily with product managers, designers, and other product engineers. You'll bring the technical perspective that makes a design better, explain constraints in terms of what they cost the user, and sweat the details other people skip: empty states, error messages, loading behavior, the edge case that only bites 2% of accounts

YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

- You'd rather own an outcome than a ticket. You take ambiguous problems, decide what to build, drive it across team boundaries, and follow through after launch. Nobody has to hand you a spec

- You're obsessed with making an experience smooth. Friction offends you. You notice the extra click, the confusing label, the query that takes 400ms too long - and you fix them instead of filing them

- You solve problems for customers, not for the codebase. Sentry's users are developers, so you can read their bug reports, sit in their tooling, and tell the difference between what they asked for and what they need

- You communicate well in writing. Working across SDK teams, ingest teams, product, and design in a distributed company means your docs, PR descriptions, and updates do a lot of the work

- You like being full-stack. You don't need a handoff to change an API and the component that calls it, and you enjoy holding the whole path from event payload to rendered pixel in your head

QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of professional experience building and shipping full-stack web applications

- Strong experience with React and TypeScript, and with Python (Django or similar) backed by a relational database such as PostgreSQL - depth in one side and real competence in the other is fine

- A track record of driving non-trivial projects end to end, including the parts that require getting other teams to agree with you

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills

- Experience leveraging AI-powered development tools to enhance productivity and code quality

BONUS POINTS

- Familiarity with the application monitoring and observability space

- Experience building developer-facing pr

About Us

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights.

About the Role

 

The Dispute Team owns what happens after a chargeback lands. We build Dispute Resolve and the Chargeback Management System (CBMS): the platform through which merchants and Riskified's own dispute operators receive chargebacks, decide whether to fight them, generate compelling evidence, submit it to the bank through payment gateways, and track the outcome to financial close.

Our domain is the full dispute lifecycle: pre-dispute alerts, chargeback ingestion and order matching, a rules-based representment decision engine, evidence generation (templated and LLM-based), gateway submission, second chargebacks and arbitration, and reimbursement when Riskified carries the liability. Under the hood this is an event-driven system of Scala and TypeScript (NestJS) microservices on Kafka, backed by CockroachDB and Elasticsearch, with a React console on top.

This role requires strong technical execution paired with genuine curiosity about how card-network disputes work.

• Embrace modern workflows : Actively use agentic coding tools and AI-assisted workflows to raise team velocity and code quality.

• Bridge tech and business: Partner with Product, dispute operations, and payments domain experts to translate card-network rules, liability logic, and merchant configuration into clean software architecture.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Software Engineer to join a highly innovative deep-tech environment, working on complex engineering challenges at the intersection of software and AI
This is a hands-on, customer-facing role where you will work across the full stack to understand customer problems, rapidly prototype solutions, and build production-ready applications that deliver real value.
The Role
You will:

• Work directly with customers to understand their engineering challenges and shape impactful software solutions.

• Build rapid prototypes, gather user feedback, and iterate toward production-ready applications.

• Develop and maintain REST APIs and microservices using Python and FastAPI .

• Work with data scientists and machine learning engineers to bring advanced physics models into customer-facing applications.

• Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience delivering applications to production.

• Strong experience with Python , backend development, REST APIs, and microservices.

• Experience working with AWS

• Ability to take ownership of complex problems and drive solutions end-to-end.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments.

• Excellent communication skills and confidence working directly with customers.

Nice to Have

• Background in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Aerospace, or another engineering discipline.

• Experience with scientific computing, machine learning, simulation, or physics-based applications.

• Experience in a customer-facing, solutions engineering, consulting, or forward-deployed role.

Working Conditions

• Full-time, 40h/week

• 1099 Contract initially

• PTO provided

• Background check required

Our values
We are a company that seeks the best for both our employees and clients, reaching beyond expectations in turning dreams into reality. Founded in 2005, IT Labs is an international software tech company, specializing in purpose and process-driven teams for high-performance, innovation, transformation, and efficiency. Our HQ is in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, and we have teams around the world - the UK, the Netherlands, Brazil, Argentina, Serbia, Croatia, BIH, Montenegro, North Macedonia, and the Middle East. title: Staff Research Scientist, Reinforce Learning
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for Research Scientists to join Wayve Labs and help build the next generation of AI systems for autonomous driving. You’ll work at the intersection of machine learning, simulation, robotics, and real-world deployment, contributing to core innovations that push the boundaries of embodied AI.

Situated within Wayve, we are a high-conviction research team with the strategic patience and backing to prioritise multi-year breakthroughs over incremental gains. We are looking for highly motivated individuals with expertise and passion to push the frontier of embodied AI, including (but not limited to) the following areas:

World & Reward Modeling: Building realistic, diverse simulators that can predict the consequences and costs of actions.

Representation Learning & Spatial Intelligence: Advancing how machines truly understand and navigate dynamic, unstructured 3D environments, from detailed spatial understanding, to efficient long term memory.

Scalable Decision-Making Systems: Designing architectures, reasoning systems, and policy learning algorithms that operate over long contexts, and scale with data and compute.

Cross-Embodiment and Multimodal Learning: Advance embodied learning systems that can flexibly adapt to diverse robotic platforms and multimodal inputs, using vision, language, and active sensors.  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Develop World Models and Planners (e.g., diffusion-based, autoregressive, or hybrid approaches) for realistic and consistent simulation

- Advance Reinforcement Learning and Reward Modeling, building scalable and safe learning frameworks across real and synthetic data

- Develop Geometric Foundation Models for 3D spatial understanding in dynamic, real-world environments.

- Enable Cross-Embodiment Robotics, leveraging the power of multimodal foundation models to accelerate robotic learning on diverse platforms.

- Conduct empirical research on Scaling laws, Generalisation, and Sim-to-real transfer

- Define and evolve Evaluation Frameworks and Benchmarks for long-horizon prediction, scene fidelity, and driving performance

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Must-haves:

- 3+ years of experience developing and deploying ML systems in real-world or production settings

- PhD, Master’s degree, or equivalent experience in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Robotics, or a related field

- Deep expertise in one or more core Embodied AI areas, such as:

- Foundation models (e.g., transformers, MoE, large-scale training)

- Generative world modeling (e.g., diffusion, autoregressive, hybrid approaches)

- Reinforcement learning (e.g., offline RL, RLHF, reward modeling)

- Spatial AI (e.g., SLAM/SfM, depth estimation, multi-view geometry with multimodal sensors)

- Track record of publications at top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, CoRL)

- Strong programming skills in Python, with experience using frameworks such as PyTorch

- A data-centric mindset, with experience working on large-scale datasets and evaluation

- Strong problem-solving ability and the ability to collaborate effectively in interdisciplinary teams

Nice-to-haves:

- Experience in autonomous driving, robotics, or simulation systems

- Familiarity with large-scale training (e.g., FSDP, DeepSpeed, JAX)

- Experience with sim-to-real transfer or data-efficient learning

- Contributions to open-source ML tools or research infrastructure

WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

- Attractive compensation with salary and equity 

- Immersion in a team of world-class researchers, engineers and entrepreneurs 

- A unique position to shape the future of autonomy and tackle the biggest challenge of our time

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

- Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant - Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

- Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges - Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

- Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world - Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, analysis, validation and realisation of Proxima’s Alpha stellarator fusion machine. Your innovative and detailed engineering work will deliver robust mechanical, structural, and thermal performance of critical systems, tooling and manufacturing processes. You will also work with external collaborators and suppliers to develop the designs, equipment, systems and materials that will enable Proxima’s mission to deliver clean, sustainable fusion energy.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Develop innovative solutions and detailed mechanical designs for significant systems within the Alpha stellarator, ensuring integration with the broader physics, mechanical and structural systems.

- Carry out thermal and structural analysis and assessment of mechanical designs, providing design input and implementing recommended design improvements.

- Conduct technology trade-offs, materials selections and feasibility studies to facilitate the successful identification of the Alpha net energy stellarator.

- Design, deliver, and support the prototyping and verification of the components, materials, assemblies and manufacturing processes selected for Alpha.

- Work with external suppliers and collaborators to assist and guide the development and manufacture of the components and systems that will come together to demonstrate the net energy Alpha stellarator.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

title: Detection & Response Engineer
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Open to hiring remote - we also have offices in New York, San Francisco, Seattle, London, Paris, and Tel Aviv.

Runway is hiring a Detection & Response Engineer to own how we find and stop attacks against our infrastructure, our research environment and our products.

Securing a company that trains and serves frontier video models is a different problem from securing a typical SaaS product. The environment includes research compute, large training datasets, a fast-moving build pipeline and engineers who work inside AI-assisted tooling every day. Each of those changes what an attack looks like and what you need to see to catch it.

You'll join the Security team and build our detection and response program the way an engineer would: detections as code, response as automation, evidence as something you can query. This is a role with real ownership: you'll own the detection program end to end, from what we log to how quickly we close an incident. You'll report to the head of security, partner with engineers across platform and research, and shape how this function grows from here.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own detection and response end to end: what we log, what we alert on, how we triage and how we recover

- Write and tune detections as code across multiple cloud environments, Kubernetes, identity systems, endpoints and SaaS, and measure them on coverage and precision rather than alert volume

- Lead incident response from the first alert through containment and forensics, then write the post-incident review people actually read

- Build automation that takes toil out of triage, including enrichment, correlation, containment actions and evidence collection, and use LLM-based tooling where it holds up under audit

- Monitor AI agents and developer tooling operating inside our environment, and turn that into concrete telemetry and controls

- Partner with platform and research engineers so new systems ship with logging and response playbooks in place on day one

- Run threat hunts and tabletop exercises against the parts of the environment that worry you most, and fix what you find

- Turn incident and detection metrics into evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and enterprise customer security reviews, working with our GRC team

- Participate in an on-call rotation for security incidents

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Hands-on incident response experience: you've triaged live alerts, led investigations and written up what happened afterward

- Experience building and tuning detections in a modern SIEM, ideally managed as code

- Working knowledge of how attackers move through cloud and Kubernetes environments (IAM abuse, container escape, credential theft, supply chain compromise) and what that leaves behind in logs

- Comfort writing Python, Typescript, Rust or another language to automate response work and connect security tools

- Familiarity with at least one major cloud platform and with Kubernetes at the level of audit logs, RBAC and workload identity

- Clear writing. In

We are looking for a Telesales Quality Assurance & Training Analyst to join our Retention Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

Role Overview
As Telesales QA & Training Analyst, you'll sit at the point where sales performance meets customer protection, listening to real conversations, spotting where agents need support, and helping build the training that closes those gaps.

About M-KOPA
M-KOPA has grown to 10 million customers across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, and South Africa, extending over $2 billion in credit to people building better lives one asset at a time. 86% of our customers report improved satisfaction, and 55% are accessing formal financial services for the first time through us. Behind that scale sits a network of over 35,000 field agents and 2,300+ employees, all working toward one goal: helping Every Day Earners own more, faster.

This is an hybrid role , you would be working from our offices in Nigeria , partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa.
What makes this different
This isn't a quality-checklist job. Every evaluation you run and every coaching session you support feeds directly into whether an agent explains a payment plan correctly, whether a customer understands what they're signing up for, and whether M-KOPA keeps the trust that got us to 10 million customers. Your findings shape real training content, not just a compliance report nobody reads.
What You'll Do

• Conduct quality evaluations of Telesales inbound, outbound, and non-voice interactions, assessing adherence to sales processes, compliance requirements, and customer communication standards.

• Analyze customer interactions to identify recurring objections, sales barriers, and performance gaps, and prepare quality and training reports for the QA & Training Lead.

• Support the design and delivery of onboarding and refresher training, developing call guides and learning materials to close identified skill gaps.

• Deliver structured coaching and feedback to agents based on QA findings, and support the QA & Training Lead in monitoring resulting action plans.

• Any other tasks as assigned by the hiring manager.

What You'll Need

• A Bachelor's degree in business administration, marketing, communications, or a related field.

• Demonstrated 2 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Training, Coaching, Telesales, or Contact Centre Operations.

• Proven experience in call quality monitoring and performance analysis, with proficiency in CRM systems and data-informed decision-making.

The honest part
This role means spending real time in the detail: listening back through calls, spotting patterns others miss, and having direct, sometimes difficult feedback conversations with agents. If you'd rather sit above the data than in it, this isn't the seat for you.
Ready to help us get the small moments right, at scale? Let's talk.

We're looking for smart, self-motivated, problem-solving Inside Sales Representatives to join our Sales team at CompanyCam. If you're passionate about sales, this is the perfect role for you! As an Inside Sales Representative, you’ll identify and engage with leads, deliver tailored demos, and help contractors improve their businesses with our software. We value a fun, fast-paced environment and are searching for individuals who thrive on building relationships and contributing to our growing success.

Location: This role is remote in England. You must have the legal right to work in the UK.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Inside Sales Rep and Actively reach out to inbound leads who have inquired about CompanyCam through various channels.

- Identify and address contractors' needs and pain points through tailored sales presentations to a diverse audience, including contractors, project managers, and business owners.

- Communicate CompanyCam’s value proposition to help contractors save time and improve business operations.

- Qualify leads and schedule demos daily to drive product engagement.

- Educate users on product features and act as an onboarding representative for trial users.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with prospects, understand their goals, and offer customized solutions.

- Manage an ongoing pipeline of prospects to deliver new customers consistently at or above our sales quota level.

- Thrive in a fast-paced environment, using multiple systems to manage prospects and sales activities.

- Actively participate in team meetings for feedback and performance improvement.

THE IMPACT YOU'LL HAVE

At CompanyCam, your work makes a real impact. Whether you're writing code, supporting customers, or designing experiences, your contributions directly shape the product we deliver and the people we serve. - Strengthening cross-functional alignment by sharing customer insights with Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Product to refine messaging and roadmap priorities, supporting smooth post-sale handoffs by partnering with Customer Success, and working with RevOps on process improvements.

- 1+ years of experience working within a CRM tool, such as Salesforce, is preferred.

- 1+ years of experience with directly selling software and leading product demonstrations preferred.

- Strong negotiation and closing skills, with a focus on driving revenue growth and achieving sales targets.
